entries.name: Shaking hands
entries.effect: Your next roll is one die smaller.

entries.name: Tunnel vision
entries.effect: You cannot help allies until the chapter ends.

entries.name: Hear it
entries.effect: The TOME whispers. It slips an extra Leaf into this trial.

entries.name: Run
entries.effect: Flee the scene by the nearest exit, even into danger.

entries.name: Lash out
entries.effect: Attack the nearest creature, friend or not.

entries.name: Gutted
entries.effect: Your minimum Stress rises by 1 permanently.

entries.name: Freeze
entries.effect: Take 1 Harm and lose your next two actions.

entries.name: Phobia
entries.effect: Gain a permanent phobia tied to this moment; facing it costs 1 Stress each time.

entries.name: The slab answers
entries.effect: The TOME takes control of you for one chapter. Remove 2 Lumen dice.
